search.title: Search across web and proprietary data sources
search.description: Search the web, academic journals, financial databases, and 40+ proprietary data sources. Returns ranked results with extracted content, ready for RAG pipelines and AI agents. Results are ranked by relevance using semantic reranking (unless `fast_mode` is enabled). You only pay for results returned - pricing is CPM-based (cost per mille tokens). Integrating search into an agent? Consider DeepResearch - a cost-effective autonomous agent built on top of this search engine, purpose-built for knowledge work.

query.description: The search query to execute. Supports natural language queries.

max_num_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Higher limits (up to 100) available on request. Provider default: 5.

search_type.description: Controls which data sources are searched. - `all` - Web and proprietary sources (default). An LLM router selects the best sources for your query. - `web` - Web search only. Best for current events and general topics. - `proprietary` - Academic, financial, and premium sources only. Best for research and technical analysis. - `news` - News articles only. Best for recent news and current events.

max_price.description: Maximum budget in CPM (cost per mille/thousand tokens). When not set, automatically calculated based on `max_num_results` and `search_type`.

relevance_threshold.description: Minimum relevance score (0.0-1.0) for results after reranking. Results below this threshold are filtered out. Provider default: 0.5.

included_sources.description: Sources to include in the search. Accepts: - Domain names or URLs for web filtering (e.g. `"arxiv.org"`, `"https://arxiv.org"`) - Dataset identifiers for proprietary sources (e.g. `"valyu/valyu-arxiv"`) - Preset names that expand to curated source groups: `"academic"`, `"finance"`, `"patent"`, `"transportation"`, `"politics"`, `"legal"`, `"health"`, `"genomics"`, `"chemistry"`, `"physics"` - `"web"` keyword to explic…

excluded_sources.description: Sources to exclude from the search. Same format as `included_sources` except presets are not supported.

source_biases.description: Bias values for specific sources to influence ranking without hard filtering. Keys are domains (e.g., 'nasa.gov') or URL paths (e.g., 'nih.gov/research'). Values are integers from -5 (strong demotion) to +5 (strong boost). Most specific path match wins.

instructions.description: Natural language instructions to help rank results by relevance to user intent. Acts as a system prompt for the search. Max 500 characters. Ignored when fast_mode is true.

category.description: Deprecated. Use `instructions` instead. Falls back to this value if `instructions` is not set.

is_tool_call.description: Indicates whether this request originates from an AI tool call. Affects query rewriting behavior. Provider default: True.

response_length.description: Controls the maximum character length of content per result. - `"short"` - 25,000 characters (default) - `"medium"` - 50,000 characters - `"large"` - 100,000 characters - `"max"` - No limit - Any positive integer for a custom character limit

start_date.description: Filter results published on or after this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. If set without `end_date`, defaults to today.

end_date.description: Filter results published on or before this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. If set without `start_date`, defaults to `1900-01-01`.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for geo-targeted web search results.

fast_mode.description: Bypass LLM query rewriting and reranking for lower latency. Forces web-only search. Cannot be used with `search_type: "proprietary"`. Provider default: False.

url_only.description: Return only URLs without full content extraction. Only available when `search_type` is `"web"` or `"news"`. Skips reranking. Provider default: False.

historical_cache.description: Run the search as a point-in-time query: serve the newest cached snapshot inside the `start_date`/`end_date` window instead of the latest crawl. This is what makes a historical backtest reproducible and keeps it from seeing content published after its cutoff. Also required to pass a sub-day timestamp on `start_date`/`end_date` — a full ISO-8601 datetime without it returns HTTP 400. No-op without a date range. Provider default: False.

historical_cache_strict.description: Point-in-time strictness for a `historical_cache` search. `"only"` serves ONLY content provably captured at or before `end_date`, dropping a result rather than falling back to a live crawl — use it for strict backtests, where a post-cutoff leak is worse than a missing result. `"prefer"` (the default) serves an in-window snapshot when one exists and otherwise falls back to a LIVE crawl so the query is never empty.

include_abstracts.description: Expand PubMed search from papers with available full text to the complete abstract corpus. Results include the abstract and, when full text is available, the most relevant full-text chunks. Has no effect on other sources. Provider default: False.

error.description: Error or warning message. May be non-empty even on successful responses if some sources had issues.

tx_id.description: Transaction ID for tracking and support.

results_by_source.description: Count of results broken down by source type.

total_deduction_dollars.description: Total cost charged for this search in USD.

total_characters.description: Sum of all result content lengths in characters.

warnings.description: Warning messages, if any (e.g. collection resolution warnings). Only present when warnings exist.

extract_contents.title: Extract clean, structured content from URLs
extract_contents.description: Turn any web page into clean, structured data. Extract content from up to 10 URLs per request with optional AI-powered summaries, structured extraction via JSON schemas, and screenshot capture. - Synchronous (default): Returns extracted content directly - Async: Set `async: true` to process in the background and poll a `job_id` - Pay-per-success: Only charged for URLs that are successfully processed ($0.001/URL, +$0.001 with AI features). Failed URLs are free - Partial / total failure: A `206` is returned when some URLs fail; a `422` is returned when every URL fails

urls.description: URLs to extract content from. Must be valid HTTP/HTTPS URLs. Duplicates are silently removed.

response_length.description: Maximum character length of extracted content per URL. - `"short"` - 25,000 characters (default) - `"medium"` - 50,000 characters - `"large"` - 100,000 characters - `"max"` - No limit - Any positive integer for a custom character limit

max_price_dollars.description: Maximum budget in USD for this request. If estimated cost exceeds this, the request is rejected. Defaults to 2x the maximum possible cost.

summary.description: Controls AI-powered content processing. Adds $0.001 per URL when enabled. - `false` - No AI processing, raw extracted content only (default) - `true` - Generate a text summary of each page - `"string"` - Generate a summary guided by custom instructions (max 500 characters) - `{json_schema}` - Extract structured data matching the provided JSON schema

extract_effort.description: Controls how pages are rendered for extraction. - `"auto"` - Automatically selects the best method per URL (default) - `"normal"` - HTTP-only extraction, fastest - `"high"` - Full Chrome rendering, best for JavaScript-heavy pages

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of each page. Screenshot URL returned in `screenshot_url` field of each result. Provider default: False.

async.description: Process URLs asynchronously in the background. Returns a `job_id` to poll via `GET /v1/contents/jobs/{job_id}`. Useful for slow, JavaScript-heavy pages. Provider default: False.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL to receive a webhook POST when async processing completes. Only used when `async` is `true`. The webhook payload is signed with HMAC-SHA256.

error.description: Error message if some URLs failed. `null` on complete success.

urls_failed.description: Number of URLs that failed processing.

total_cost_dollars.description: Total cost in USD (only successful URLs are charged).

total_characters.description: Sum of all result content lengths.

get_contents_job.title: Poll async content extraction job status
get_contents_job.description: Check the status and retrieve results of an async content extraction job.

job_id.description: The job ID returned by the async contents request.
Unique identifier for the async job.

status.description: Current job status. - `pending` - Job created, not yet started - `processing` - URLs are being processed - `completed` - All URLs processed successfully - `part…

urls_total.description: Total number of URLs to process.

urls_processed.description: Number of URLs successfully processed so far.

urls_failed.description: Number of URLs that failed processing.

created_at.description: Job creation time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

current_batch.description: Current batch being processed. Only present when `status` is `"processing"`.

total_batches.description: Total number of batches. Only present when `status` is `"processing"`.

results.description: Extraction results. Only present when `status` is `"completed"` or `"partial"`.

actual_cost_dollars.description: Total cost in USD. Only present when processing is complete.

error.description: Error message. Only present when `status` is `"failed"` or `"partial"`.

answer.title: Get AI-powered answers with real-time search
answer.description: Get a grounded, cited answer to one question: Valyu searches web, academic and financial sources in real time, then an AI synthesises the findings. The REST endpoint replies as a Server-Sent Events transcript rather than one JSON object: `search_results` events list sources, `content` events carry answer text chunks (OpenAI delta format), and the final `metadata` event holds the full result, token usage and cost before `data: [DONE]`. Costs about $0.10 plus search and token usage. Use search for raw ranked results, or create_deep_research_task for multi-step research and reports.

query.description: The question or research query to answer.

search_type.description: Controls which data sources are searched. - `all` - Web and proprietary sources (default) - `web` - Web search only - `proprietary` - Academic, financial, and premium sources only - `news` - News articles only

included_sources.description: Sources to include. Accepts domains, URLs, dataset identifiers, or presets (`"finance"`, `"medical"`).

excluded_sources.description: Sources to exclude. Same format as `included_sources` except presets are not supported.

data_max_price.description: Maximum budget in USD for the search data component. Converted to CPM internally. Provider default: 1.0.

start_date.description: Filter results published on or after this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

end_date.description: Filter results published on or before this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for geo-targeted search.

fast_mode.description: Enable fast mode for lower latency. Uses 3 tool call rounds instead of 2 and higher result counts per query. Provider default: False.

structured_output.description: JSON Schema defining the desired output structure. When set, the AI returns a JSON object matching this schema instead of free-form text. Max depth 10, max 50 properties, max 5000 characters.

system_instructions.description: Custom system instructions for the AI. Replaces the default research agent prompt. Max 2000 characters.

output.description: The SSE transcript as text: `data: {json}` lines for search_results, content chunks and a final metadata event, ending with `data: [DONE]`.

create_deep_research_task.title: Create a DeepResearch task
create_deep_research_task.description: Start an async research task that performs comprehensive, multi-step research. The research agent searches multiple sources, analyzes content, executes code, and generates a detailed report with citations. Tasks run in the background and typically take 1-10 minutes depending on the `mode`. Poll the status endpoint or use webhooks to get results.

query.description: The research query or question. Use `query` (preferred) or `input` (deprecated). Maximum 25,000 characters. Mutually exclusive with `workflow_id`.

workflow_id.description: Beta. Slug of a workflow to run instead of a freeform query. When set, the task is resolved from the workflow's prompt template using `workflow_params`. Mutually exclusive with freeform fields (`query`, `input`, `research_strategy`, `report_format`); supplying both returns `400 workflow_and_freeform_mutually_exclusive`. See the Workflows endpoints.

workflow_params.description: Beta. Values for the workflow's template variables, keyed by variable `key`. Required when `workflow_id` is set. Values must satisfy the workflow's declared variable types and validation rules.

workflow_version.description: Beta. Pin the run to a specific immutable version of the workflow. Defaults to the workflow's current version when omitted. Only valid with `workflow_id`.

mode.description: Research mode controlling depth and cost. Mode Price Best For Max Steps --- --- --- --- `fast` $0.10 Quick queries, batch processing 10 `standard` $0.50 Balanced research 15 `heavy` $2.50 Complex topics requiring deep analysis 15 `max` $15.00 Exhaustive research with maximum quality 25. Provider default: standard.

strategy.description: Deprecated. Use `research_strategy` instead. Natural language strategy to guide the research agent's approach.

research_strategy.description: Natural language strategy to guide the research phase. Controls how the agent searches, what sources to prioritize, and research methodology. Combined length of `research_strategy` and `report_format` must not exceed 15,000 characters.

report_format.description: Natural language instructions for the output format. Has highest priority and overrides default formatting. Controls structure, style, length, and presentation of the final report. Combined length of `research_strategy` and `report_format` must not exceed 15,000 characters.

search.description: Search configuration for DeepResearch tasks. Fields: search_type, included_sources, excluded_sources, source_biases, country_code, start_date, end_date.

urls.description: URLs to include in the research context. Max 10.

files.description: Files to analyze as part of the research. Max 10. Each item is an object. Fields: data, filename, mediaType, context. Required: data, filename, mediaType.

output_formats.description: Desired output formats. Defaults to `["markdown"]`. - `"markdown"` - Markdown report (default) - `"pdf"` - PDF document (can combine with `"markdown"`) - `"toon"` - Token-efficient structured output; requires a JSON Schema object to also be supplied - JSON Schema object - Structured JSON output A JSON Schema object cannot be combined with `"markdown"` or `"pdf"`. `"toon"` requires a JSON Schema object. Each item is an object.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata to attach to the task.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers to provide additional tools during research. Max 5. Each item is an object. Fields: url, name, tool_prefix, auth, allowed_tools. Required: url.

code_execution.description: Deprecated: use tools.code_execution instead. Enable code execution capability. Provider default: False.

tools.description: Controls which optional tools the research agent can use. Each tool accepts an object with `enabled` (boolean, default true) and optional `max_calls` (integer, capped at system default). Fields: code_execution, screenshots, browser_use, charts.

previous_reports.description: DeepResearch task IDs to use as context for this task. Max 3.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL to receive a webhook POST when the task completes. Signed with HMAC-SHA256.

alert_email.description: Email notification on completion. Pass a string (email address) or an object with email and optional custom_url. The custom_url must contain {id} which gets replaced with the task ID. Email must belong to your organization.

deliverables.description: Deliverable files to generate from the research (e.g. Excel reports, presentations). Max 10. Each item is an object.

hitl.description: Human-in-the-loop configuration. Enable checkpoints that pause execution at key decision points. Not available for batch requests. Fields: planning_questions, plan_review, source_review, outline_review.

deepresearch_id.description: Unique identifier for the research task.

status.description: Initial task status. `"running"` if started immediately, `"queued"` if waiting for capacity.

mode.description: Research mode used for this task.

public.description: Whether the task is publicly accessible.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for verifying webhook payloads. Only present when `webhook_url` was provided.

message.description: Status message. Present when task is queued.

get_deep_research_task.title: Get DeepResearch task status and results
get_deep_research_task.description: Retrieve the current status, progress, and results of a DeepResearch task. Poll this endpoint to track research progress and retrieve the final output.

deepresearch_id.description: Unique identifier for the research task.

status.description: Current task status. - `queued` - Waiting for capacity - `running` - Research in progress - `awaiting_input` - HITL checkpoint active, waiting for user response…

mode.description: Research mode used for this task.

output_formats.description: Output formats requested for this task.

public.description: Whether the task results are publicly accessible.

batch_id.description: Batch ID if this task belongs to a batch.

batch_task_id.description: User-provided task ID within a batch.

output_type.description: Format of the output. Present when `status` is `"completed"`.

output.description: Research output. Markdown string or JSON object depending on `output_type`. Present when `status` is `"completed"` (may be partial on `"failed"` or `"cancelled"…

sources.description: Sources used during research. Present when `status` is `"completed"`, `"failed"`, or `"cancelled"`.

cost.description: Total cost billed for this task in USD (base mode price + any tool surcharges).

list_deep_research_tasks.title: List DeepResearch tasks
list_deep_research_tasks.description: Retrieve a list of all DeepResearch tasks for the authenticated API key.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

add_deep_research_instruction.title: Add a follow-up instruction to a running task
add_deep_research_instruction.description: Send a follow-up instruction to a running DeepResearch task. The instruction can only be added before the writing phase begins. Use this to steer the research in a specific direction based on intermediate findings.

instruction.description: Follow-up instruction for the research agent.

cancel_deep_research_task.title: Cancel a running or queued task
cancel_deep_research_task.description: Cancel a DeepResearch task that is currently running or queued. Completed, failed, or already cancelled tasks cannot be cancelled.

delete_deep_research_task.title: Delete a completed, failed, or cancelled task
delete_deep_research_task.description: Permanently delete a DeepResearch task and its associated data (output, sources, PDF, images). Running or queued tasks must be cancelled first.

set_deep_research_task_public.title: Toggle public access for a task
set_deep_research_task_public.description: Toggle the public visibility of a DeepResearch task. When set to `true`, the task results become accessible via a public share link without authentication. Only the task owner can modify the public flag.

public.description: Set to `true` to make the task publicly accessible, or `false` to make it private.

respond_to_deep_research_checkpoint.title: Respond to a HITL checkpoint
respond_to_deep_research_checkpoint.description: Respond to a human-in-the-loop checkpoint. The task must be in `awaiting_input` or `paused` status. Pass the `interaction_id` from the task's `interaction` field along with the response data matching the checkpoint type.

interaction_id.description: The interaction_id from the task's interaction field.

response.description: Response data — shape depends on the checkpoint type (`interaction.type`). One of: Planning Questions Response, Plan Review Response, Source Review Response, Outline Review Response.

status.description: `running` if container was still alive, `queued` if task was re-enqueued from paused state.

list_deep_research_batches.title: List all batches
list_deep_research_batches.description: List all batches. Retrieve all batches for the authenticated API key.

create_deep_research_batch.description: Create a batch for running multiple DeepResearch tasks with shared configuration. After creation, add tasks with the Add Tasks endpoint. The batch transitions from `open` to `processing` when tasks are added.

output_formats.description: Output formats applied to all tasks. Each item is an object.

status.description: Batch lifecycle status. - `open` - Batch created, accepting tasks - `processing` - Tasks are running - `completed` - All tasks finished successfully - `complete…

get_deep_research_batch.title: Get batch status
get_deep_research_batch.description: Retrieve the current status, task counts, and aggregated cost of a batch.

list_deep_research_batch_tasks.title: List tasks in a batch
list_deep_research_batch_tasks.description: Retrieve tasks within a batch with optional status filtering and cursor-based pagination. add_deep_research_batch_tasks.description: Add up to 100 research tasks to an existing batch. The batch must be in `open` or `processing` status.

Created tasks with their assigned IDs.

cancel_deep_research_batch.title: Cancel a batch
cancel_deep_research_batch.description: Cancel all queued and running tasks in a batch. The batch must be in `open` or `processing` status.

list_datasources.title: List available data sources
list_datasources.description: Discover all data sources available through Valyu's search API. Each datasource includes metadata, example queries (optimized for few-shot prompting), pricing information, and response schemas. Use this endpoint to build dynamic tool manifests for AI agents instead of hardcoding knowledge of available datasets.

category.description: Filter datasources by category. Use the categories endpoint to discover available categories.

list_datasource_categories.title: List datasource categories
list_datasource_categories.description: Retrieve all available datasource categories. Use these to filter the datasources endpoint. Categories include: `research`, `healthcare`, `markets`, `company`, `economic`, `predictions`, `transportation`, `legal`, `politics`, `patents`.

search_datasources.title: Search datasources
search_datasources.description: Find datasets by describing what you need in natural language, e.g. `Wiley medical literature`, `FDA drug labels`, `insider transactions`, `CPI inflation`. Ranking is semantic (embedding similarity) blended with exact-term matching, so both descriptive phrases and terse acronyms work. Use the returned `id` values as `included_sources` on the Search API. Results are ranked best-first with a `relevance_score` in the range 0-1; a query matching nothing in the catalog returns an empty list rather than a weak guess. Only datasets your key can search are returned (the same visibility rules as `GET /v1/datasources`).

q.description: Natural-language description of the data you want.

limit.description: Maximum number of datasets to return.

search_mode.description: `semantic` when embedding-based ranking was used; `lexical` when the full-text fallback served the request.

results.description: Each item is an object. Fields: id, name, description, category, type, topics, languages, source, modality, example_queries, pricing, response_schema, update_fr

scope.description: Which workflows to return: `valyu` (curated only), `org` (your org only), or `all` (both, default).

q.description: Free-text search across title, subtitle, and description.

verticals.description: Distinct verticals present across the curated catalog.

list_workflow_versions.description: Beta. List all immutable versions of a workflow, newest first.

versions.description: Each item is an object. Fields: version, recommended_mode, estimated_time, changelog, created_at, is_current. Required: version.

get_workflow_version.title: Get a specific workflow version (Beta)
get_workflow_version.description: Beta. Retrieve a workflow resolved at a specific immutable version. Returns the same flat workflow object as `GET /v1/workflows/{slug}?version={n}`.

output.description: The workflow resolved at the requested version.

slug.description: Unique slug identifying the workflow within its scope. Used as `workflow_id` when running.

description.description: Longer description of what the workflow does.

popular.description: Whether the workflow is flagged as popular.

recommended_mode.description: Recommended DeepResearch mode for a workflow. Maps directly to the DeepResearch `mode` parameter.

estimated_time.description: Human-readable estimate of how long a run takes.

is_valyu.description: Whether this is a Valyu-curated workflow (read-only to users).

owner_org_id.description: Organization that owns the workflow. `null` for Valyu-curated workflows.

variables.description: Typed variables referenced by the prompt template. Up to 50.

deliverables.description: Deliverables the workflow produces. Up to 20.

preview_workflow.title: Preview a resolved workflow (Beta)
preview_workflow.description: Beta. Resolve a workflow's prompt template against supplied `workflow_params` without running it. Returns the resolved prompt, research strategy, report format, deliverables, recommended mode, and tools - exactly what a run would use. Useful for validating parameters before incurring a DeepResearch cost.

workflow_params.description: Values for the workflow's template variables, keyed by variable `key`.

workflow_version.description: Version to preview. Defaults to the current version.

workflow.description: Which workflow and version were resolved.

estimated_credits.description: Estimated credit cost of a run, when available.
